title: ABH Core
intent: Attractor Before Harness 的核心结构必须收敛到一个 Git-native、证据优先、生成与验收分离的轨迹控制框架。
invariants: 每个可执行 plan 必须绑定一个 active attractor。
验证结果只能证明机器检查状态，不能直接证明计划完成。
计划关闭必须依赖独立 audit。

boundary_rules.description: Foundation modules (models, storage, errors) must not import CLI or MCP adapter modules
boundary_rules.recommendation: Models are pure data. Move adapter-specific logic to core.py or the adapter.

boundary_rules.description: Foundation modules must not import MCP server adapter
boundary_rules.recommendation: Models must not depend on transport adapters.

boundary_rules.description: Storage layer must not import CLI or MCP adapters
boundary_rules.recommendation: Storage is infrastructure. Keep adapter imports in core.py.

boundary_rules.description: CLI adapter must not directly import MCP server (use core.py)
boundary_rules.recommendation: CLI and MCP are peer adapters. Route shared logic through core.py or commands.py.

boundary_rules.description: MCP adapter must not directly import CLI adapter (use core.py)
boundary_rules.recommendation: CLI and MCP are peer adapters. Route shared logic through core.py.

dependency_rules.description: Plan modules must depend on attractor concepts
